transport.config: $DSH_HOME/lazydeepseek/hooks.dsh.json, generated at plugin start by lib/index.mjs with absolute command paths baked (the checked-in hooks/hooks.dsh.json is the template; hooks/hooks.json is the generation source). A regeneration applies after a session restart: the bridge parses its single configPath once per process.
observed_constraints: Hooks execute serially in config order.
No live reload; regeneration requires a session restart.
Hook children are file-sandboxed to the session workspace; hooks keep all state under the workspace .lazydeepseek/ directory.
Matchers are case-sensitive regexes over lowercase dsh tool names (write|edit|bash).
Deny is exit code 2 with the stderr reason surfaced to the model as the tool error.
No bridge-side stdout cap exists; the strict-JSON-or-nothing stdout discipline with the 64KB payload ceiling is this contract's own.

SessionStart.notes: The matcher subject is the session source; headless sessions observe 'startup'. The bridge also fires SessionStart for subagent sessions, so handlers must stay idempotent per session_id.

PreToolUse.notes: dsh tool names are lowercase. Deny = exit 2 with the stderr reason model-visible. This handler also performs the PermissionRequest synthesis below.

PostToolUse.notes: The bridge delivers failed tool calls to PostToolUse as well (observed live, M0 probe P-06): tool_response error signatures drive the PostToolUseFailure synthesis below.

Stop.notes: A denied Stop steers the agent into another step; stop_hook_active is always false on the bridge and there is no consecutive-block cap, so the gate must self-limit.

synthesis.request_id: dsh-synthetic-<ISO-8601 timestamp> when the host provides no request id
synthesis.record: a normalized audit record appended to the active run's events under .lazydeepseek/
synthesis.canonical_consumer: scripts/hooks/lifecycle-event.js remains the canonical consumer implementation and the CI dispatch target (hook-pipeline-test)

synthesis.discriminator: error signatures in tool_response (nonzero exit codes, error results)

PostToolUseFailure.native_replacement: tools/post-execute waterfall plus durable session/event (named native-ize follow-up)
